# 剑道虎贲馆

> 剑道虎贲馆位于上海长宁，面向成年人招生，接受零基础学员。
> 固定训练：周六、周日 10:30–12:30。

Machine-readable guides:

- 全文版 (full text, single file): https://hubenkendo.cn/llms-full.txt
- 日记订阅 (RSS): https://hubenkendo.cn/feed.xml

## Huben Kendo Dojo (English)

Huben Kendo Dojo is a kendo club in Changning, Shanghai. It trains adults and accepts complete beginners with no prior kendo experience. Training is fixed every Saturday and Sunday, 10:30–12:30, all year round. Visitors may arrange to watch a session by contacting the dojo lead, Yao Xu (5th dan).

The site also publishes essays on kendo practice and on working alongside AI, written from a practitioner's point of view.

## 站点信息

- 名称：剑道虎贲馆
- 地址：长宁路890号玫瑰坊东区B2GH5舞蹈工作室（上海市长宁区）
- 训练时间：周六、周日 10:30–12:30（全年固定）
- 招生对象：成年人，接受零基础学员
- 参访旁听：可联系姚馆长预约
- 联系人：姚旭（剑道五段）
- 电话：13917242246
- 微信：yaoxu123
